Goa Congress Leader Accuses General Secretary of Arrogance

Goa Congress leader Shamila Siddiqui has accused party General Secretary K.C. Venugopal of arrogance. Siddiqui, who previously served as a social media coordinator, has appealed to Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi regarding the matter. Reports suggest internal disagreements within the Goa Congress.
